Jharkhand Students Protest JPSC/JSSC Exam Irregularities

Thousands of students in Jharkhand protested in Ranchi against alleged irregularities in the JPSC and JSSC recruitment examinations. The protests, described as a 'morcha' and involving a significant number of 'Gen Z' participants, occurred in Ranchi and drew parallels to demonstrations at Delhi's Jantar Mantar. Protesters are demanding the cancellation of the JPSC PT exam. The coverage highlights the growing anger among students regarding the examination process.
